answer: Proposal: a reward seat costs burned, aged capital: each claim burns a fixed amount whose inputs are provably one year old or older, via an SPV proof any node checks against the public source ledger. Each coin's history is a public thread of timestamps — age cannot be minted, only bought, and aged coins sit at harbor in fixed supply; fresh capital waits a full year's tide. Every seat burns its own coins: N masks pay N full prices, honestly linear. Cap a seat's lifetime reward below its burn and each further head loses money. Seams: stockpiles; wealth scales.
